title: A MUST do trip in Barcelona 💯
text:
This is one of the best experiences I have done. I travelled with my daughter for her 21st birthday.
The transfer was luxurious and only took about half an hour, with beautiful views along the way.
The winery and cava house belongs to a family and was absolutely incredible and so welcoming - we saw some of the family going about their day. It felt very special to be welcomed to their home. Not commercialised at all and felt very authentic. 
The tour guide who is employed there full time was outstanding - so knowledgeable and passionate about the wine.

title: Awesome wine tour
text: Awesome wine tasting and winery tour. The tour guide was incredibly knowledgeable and helpful. The wine and snack pairing were excellent. Highly recommend this tour for anyone interested in wine.
author: Dave_W

title: Penedes Wine and Cava Tour
text: This tour was superb from start to finish. Antonio, our guide, was very knowledgeable and witty, so every tasting was both fun and informative. We had an amazing time and highly recommend this tour and Antonio to anyone visiting Barcelona.
author: Shelley_L

title: A wonderful experience - book it now!
text: I cannot recommend this tour enough - the vineyard, houses and cellar are beautiful and the jeep tour is great. Antonio, our guide, was incredibly warm, friendly and knowledgeable and really looked after us. On top of all this, the wines and Cava we tasted were all amazing and served with delicious finger foods to complement each.
author: stevenwV4913MT

title: Amazing experience and great guides!
text: Guides at the vineyard were amazing, wines were great, only con would be that if it’s raining at pickup, you will be wet. Loved the small group size! Would love to drink cava first as opposed to the red wines!
author: jamessY1611KR

title: Fabulous winery to visit.
text: The owners of this winery were fantastic. Told us the history of the winery. Than toured the first one. The guy talking was great explain the whole process they do on their cava. Than we got to try 3 different Cavas along with pairing of snacks. Then we got in the jeeps and drove around the winery. Than went to another building to see the cellar to see the how they store their white and red wines. Than went for another tasting of 2 white and 1 white wine with snack pairings. I definitely would do this again when visiting.
author: Jill_N
